Implemented the complete R3/R4 repair in the four batch-9 artifacts.

- R3: added `cex-solution-count-trichotomy-fails-over-a-finite-field` to Gaussian B, sourced through [Hefferon](https://jheffero.w3.uvm.edu/linearalgebra/book.pdf). Added explicit canonical dispositions for LU factorisation and rank normal form.
- R4: added `fs-determinant-is-additive-on-matrices` to determinant B, anchored to [Margalit–Rabinoff’s multilinearity treatment](https://textbooks.math.gatech.edu/ila/1553/determinants-definitions-properties.html) with an auxiliary [Purdue reference](https://www.math.purdue.edu/~chenjk/MA265Su18/Lesson11-acc.html). Corrected the nonexistent deferral home to `the-determinant-of-a-linear-operator`.
- Both additions have complete proof contracts and real `included` harvest rows.

- Gaussian: 29 A + 9 B
- Determinants: 24 A + 7 B
- 69 unique items; no split proposed
- Harvest: 92 included, 25 inline, 7 deferred, 4 out-of-scope
- Proof contracts: 56/56

Published dependencies newly relevant to these leaves were opened from disk: `thm-z-mod-p-is-a-field` and `thm-reals-field` via the literature-derived route; `def-integers-modulo-n` and `def-addition-and-multiplication-modulo-n` via the source-checked AI-altered route. The important convention boundaries are now explicit: infinite versus finite fields, and row/column multilinearity versus whole-matrix additivity.
